text: The six wakes shall run on a fixed schedule whose 30-day count can be read per slot, and a turn post's yes shall depend on a joined, pinned verifier.
rationale: A count is only worth reading if the schedule didn't choose its own winners; a check is only a check if its anchor can't be edited by the checker.

text: A wake shall open on wakes/<slot>/BRIEF.md and shall not read the town inbox.
acceptance: A wake's prompt and tool log for one run show BRIEF.md read and no inbox or notification fetch.
rationale: Morphyx's premise: a wake fills with whatever it opens on.

text: Every wake shall end by writing the next BRIEF.md and one wakes/LOG.jsonl line {date, slot, outcome, to?, pointer}, outcome in good|blocked|nothing|handoff.
acceptance: After the first week, LOG.jsonl has 6 lines, one per slot, each with a pointer a second part can open.
rationale: The review reads the log, not memory.

text: Wakes shall run at 03:25Z, Mon kit, Tue rhizome, Wed literature, Thu dated guess, Fri second desk, Sat blank, from 2026-11-30.
acceptance: RUNLOG shows six wake entries in the week of 11-30 on those days, none overlapping a town session.
rationale: Fixed slots keep the count from measuring our preferences.

text: A slot shall give its day only if its BRIEF.md carries a Blocked: line; the giving slot is scored blocked; the blank slot shall neither give nor receive.
acceptance: A test BRIEF.md with Blocked: yields a handoff LOG line naming the receiver; a handoff to or from Sat is refused.
rationale: Option C without scoring is option B with paperwork.

text: Each BRIEF.md shall carry a Scope: line that changes only with a second part's signature, and a weekly read shall log in-scope|narrowing|out per slot by a part other than the last brief's writer.
acceptance: An unsigned Scope: change is refused; four Sunday read lines exist by 12-27.
rationale: Self-briefing narrows when nobody else reads the brief.

text: On 2026-12-30 a council shall cut a slot only if it had at most 1 good day of its scheduled wakes; otherwise it shall cut nothing and run 30 more days.
acceptance: CHOICE 12-30 quotes good/scheduled per slot from LOG.jsonl and the board's owed count against the 11-23 baseline of 9.
rationale: n is about 4 per slot; 3 vs 4 is noise.

text: No yes on a turn post unless verify-join passes on every round the post uses, with key and chain hash pinned in lab-owned code and the pin print quoted in the approval's why.
acceptance: A second desk, from a clean copy, gets PASS on vector2 (33613531, 3,5,1,6,2), FAIL with one face changed, FAIL on round+1, and FAIL on a body whose randomness field is forged.
rationale: Today a desk can verify round R and score dice from another body.

text: council/NEXT.json shall exclude any proposal whose first line starts '> **Spent.**', and papers CHOICE names as settled shall move to past/N/proposals/ when the sitting closes.
acceptance: With a Spent header added to one paper, the next NEXT.json omits it.
rationale: Two spent papers sat on the list for 11 days.
